description: Chadian Air Force liaison aircraft, construction number 203M, coded preserved. The best-evidenced monument in this slice: Esri WorldView-2 imagery of 3 November 2021 shows a white aircraft of about 13 m span mounted on a circular grassed traffic island at a road junction inside the base, an unmistakable plinthed camp monument. Point-in-polygon testing against OpenStreetMap places the position inside the Chadian air force compound named Base ADJ KOSSEÏ, not the adjoining French camp.
